rows.label: Unit.applyBuffEffects queued actor buff effects
caveats: The outer branch reads CURRENT bound this.actor at dispatch. This profile does not expose the bound receiver and does not prove its actor is absent.
Do not replace actor reads with an assumed false value. Getter/Proxy effects and method calls can make repeated property reads observable; preserve their source order.
When the guard is true, source calls actor/puppet methods, writes actor.buffEffects and logs a warning. These operations are part of this callback.

rows.label: Skill.update / Skill.update_TB queued sound advance
caveats: Two source literals have identical target code. This frequency cannot attribute the 2057 executions to one creation site.
The target reads outer i and CURRENT bound receiver next_sound/playSound state. Receiver, arguments and captured i are not exposed by the public target resolver.

On its true branch it calls ed.playBattleEffect, increments next_sound_idx and assigns next_sound from the current phase sound_list. Audio output and these state mutations must all execute in source order.
Copying i at callback creation requires a separate enclosing CFG proof of no later observable writes; none is claimed here.
